LanguageData.ANP_HopperControlLabel: Manage hopper filters when idle (Smart Mode only)
LanguageData.ANP_HopperControlTooltip: If enabled, automatically clears the filters of adjacent hoppers when stock is full, and restores them when production is needed.
LanguageData.ANP_GizmoTooltip_Smart: Toggle smart production. Produces nutrient paste only when the count is below the lower threshold, and stops when it reaches the upper threshold.
LanguageData.ANP_GizmoTooltip_Continuous: Toggle continuous production. Produces nutrient paste as long as there are ingredients and power, ignoring all thresholds.
